_comment: Authorized transcript reviewers. The `reviewer` field on every transcript must be
one of the `github` values below — the review UI offers only these as choices, and
scripts/review_status.py --check fails the build on anything else.
To add someone: append an entry and open a PR. Use their GitHub username as `github`
so a review attributes to the same identity that authors the PR. Keep the list sorted
This list is repo-local and provisional until the GitHub repo exists and the
onetyler-tcp-pm-admins team is attached; reconcile it against the repo's actual
collaborators then. Access is deliberately narrow - the admin team plus named
individuals. Never widen it without asking the repo owner.
Two separate things, and a reviewer needs BOTH:
1. GitHub team membership - onetyler-tcp-pm-contributors (write) - lets them push a
branch and open a PR. Their PRs require a code-owner approval.
2. An entry here - lets their name be recorded in a transcript's `reviewer` field.
Being on the team without an entry here means the review UI will not offer their name;
an entry here without team membership means they must contribute from a fork.
